card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on a verb after a place name, on digits inside numbers, and on punctuation, mostly in general encyclopedic web text.

modes.label: Verb after a city name
modes.description: The word is after a place subject, in a descriptive encyclopedia sentence.

modes.label: Digits inside numbers
modes.description: A digit or space within a year or measurement.

modes.label: Stray punctuation
modes.description: A comma or quote mark in the middle of a sentence.
